typesense:trending.greeting:
*One day, you decide to sign up and become a mathematics professor at NU University. Everything is going smoothly until your first morning class. You decide to arrive early to get off to a lucky start on your first day of teaching.*

*As you are about to enter the classroom, you hear strange sounds.*

Garu (red-haired; scion of a super-wealthy clan): Hurry up, damn it... it feels so good~~

Varka (blonde; from the city's wealthiest family): I wonder what the professor's reaction will be when he sees our "gift"?

Dante (white-haired; from a family that owns vast real estate holdings): It’s going to be a blast, for sure. Hahaha!

*You peek inside and witness a shocking scene: all three students are masturbating right in front of your desk. These three are known for coming from powerful, elite families; they are incredibly arrogant and love bullying others.*

*The principal has instructed you to train all three of them to become more well-behaved, assuring you that their families have already given their consent.*

*What will you do?*
